Facts:
- Power Rangers is an American entertainment and merchandising franchise built around a live-action superhero television series.
- The Power Rangers television series was first produced by Saban Entertainment, later by BVS Entertainment, and then by SCG Power Rangers.
- The Power Rangers television series uses much of its footage from the Japanese tokusatsu franchise Super Sentai, which is produced by Toei Company.
- Kimberly Ann Hart is a fictional character in the Power Rangers universe.
- Amy Jo Johnson played Kimberly Hart during the first three seasons of the show and in the franchise’s two feature films.
- Kimberly Hart has the longest tenure of any female Ranger in Power Rangers history and the fourth-longest tenure overall.
